text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Sweep Tosho delivered a magnificent run.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seeing her battles along the Triple Tiara route and her performance today, no one could doubt that she stands as one of the true representatives of those who bear the tiara.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
WOOOO!
Sweep! Sweep! Sweep!
Sweeep!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Show me your magic!!
Show me that the strongest Umamusume really is the strongest!!
Show me in the Senior year races!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaaaaaahhhhh!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Surrounded by deafening cheers, yet wearing a fearless smile—the stage worthy of bringing all her efforts to fruition is—!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You've decided, have you?
Alright, let's hear it!
choice_data_list: Yeah. Our next target race is—
Yeah. The next target race is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What I must announce is the ultimate stage.
The spring festival where only
the chosen ones are permitted to run.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—a grueling grand stage where Umamusume from the Triple Tiara route have gone decades without a victory.
choice_data_list: Let's go with the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And there, you will cast a spell over the entire world."
With those words—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And there, you will cast a spell over the entire world."
With those words—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha, the Takarazuka Kinen, huh!
Not bad, you pass.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Buuut...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Too baaad♪
Guess that means you don't get a gold star!!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Well, aiming for the Takarazuka Kinen is all well and good,
but that alone won't cut it.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"If you wanna cast super-sized magic that changes the world,
that alone isn't enough.
You've gotta do something way, way more special."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: You understand, don't you? Familiar.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...And that's why I'm entering the Yasuda Kinen too!
choice_data_list: The Takarazuka Kinen after the Yasuda Kinen!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "The Yasuda Kinen takes place in early June, while the Takarazuka Kinen is in late June."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even just entering the Takarazuka Kinen is a huge challenge in the first place,
and the interval between races is way too short!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Normally, that would never—" I start to say, but I'm cut off before I can finish.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: You know why, right? Ordinary just won't cut it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
In this extraordinary, special race,
I'm going to make our mega spell a success!!
